== Summary ==
"I don't know much about art, but I know what I like." The image of Mara Jade draws fans to Decipher's Gallery. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
